name: Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P
tagline: High performance joint and crack sealing tape Part of the Sikadur-Combiflex® SG System
summary: Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P is a flexible waterproofing tape based on modified flexible Polyolefin (FPO) with advanced adhesion properties. Thickness 1.0 mm. The product is part of the Sikadur Combiflex® SG System.
metaDescription:
Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P is a flexible waterproofing tape based on modified flexible Polyolefin (FPO) with advanced adhesion properties. Thickness 1.0 mm.
The product is part of the Sikadur Combiflex® SG System.
attributes: Advanced adhesion, no activation on site required
Highly flexible - high crack and joint bridging ability
Performs well within a wide range of temperatures
Can be used in contact with potable/drinking water
usage: Sealing all types of joints and cracks in many different structures and applications including:
Building components where differential settlement is expected
advantages: Advanced adhesion, no activation on site required
Highly flexible - high crack and joint bridging ability
Performs well within a wide range of temperatures
Can be used in contact with potable/drinking water
packaging: 1 roll of 25 m length Refer to current price list for packaging variations

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Drinking water AS/NZS 4020, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , ams Laboratories, Test report No. 1116525
Drinking water KTW, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , HY, Certificate No. K-248079-14-Ko
Root Resistance CEN/TS 14416, Sikadur Combiflex® SG, SKZ, Test report No. 89643/09
Sanitary Compliance XP P 41-250, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , CARSO, Certificate No. 16 MAT LY 108
Water Regulations up to 50 °C BS6920-1:2000, Sikadur Combiflex® SG, WRAS, Approval No. 1708503

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions. Opened and unprotected rolls must be used within 2 months. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text: Refer to Sikadur Combiflex® SG System data sheet.

items.label: Elongation
items.text:
> 650 %
Maximum permissible permanent elongation | <10 % of non-adhered tape width
Note: For higher joint movement, loop tape into the gap of the joint.

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Tested according to EN 1847. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.

items.label: Reaction to fire
items.text: Euroclass E | (EN ISO 11925-2, classification to EN 13501-1)

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text:
+5 °C min. / +45 °C max.
(Sikadur® epoxy adhesive temperature limits apply)
